note: Map client tools of the voice agent. Shared with the web app (WS8): the viewer registers one handler per tool name with the ElevenLabs React SDK (clientTools). Arguments are copied by the voice model from the map_actions returned by ask_twin; the viewer must ignore points outside Rome. All tools are fire-and-forget (expects_response false).

tools.name: fly_to
tools.description: Move the map camera to a place. Use only the lon, lat and zoom given in a map_actions entry of the last ask_twin result. Never invent coordinates.

zoom.description: Map zoom level, copied from map_actions

label.description: Short place name to show on the map

tools.name: show_area
tools.description: Highlight an operating area on the map: 'city', a municipio id or an urban-zone id from a map_actions entry.

tools.name: show_layer
tools.description: Switch a map layer on or off, for example air quality, transit delay, rain, EMF field or schools.

layer.description: Layer id as named in map_actions or in the ask_twin data_kinds

visible.description: true to show, false to hide

tools.name: show_radius
tools.description: Draw the context circle of a permit check around a point. Office agent only. Use only values from a map_actions entry.

radius_m.description: Radius in metres, copied from map_actions

run_id.description: Run id of the context_check, copied from map_actions

tools.name: open_screen
tools.description: Open a screen of the app when the user asks to see something there.
